title: Unreal 2 Pineapple and Passionfruit 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Pineapple and Passionfruit from Unreal 2 e-liquids is a mouth-watering burst of tropical fruit flavour that drenches your tastebuds in juicy, tangy waves of flavour. This product contains 100ml of e-liquid in a 120ml shortfill bottle, with space for 2 x 10ml nicotine shots to let you tailor your juice’s nicotine content. For example, adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. The e-liquid’s 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , vape mod kits and sub-ohm tanks .
